name: Area Glance Card
description: Compact, preset-led area summaries. Configure the five most useful signals instead of composing a grid of template cards.

presets.name: Living room
presets.yaml:
type: custom:area-glance-card
title: Living
area: living_room
status:
  entity: binary_sensor.living_room_motion
  active_text: Motion
  inactive_text: No motion
  show_last_changed: true
metrics:
  - preset: temperature
    entity: sensor.living_room_temperature
  - preset: lights
    area: living_room
  - preset: power
    entity: sensor.living_room_power
  - preset: device
    entity: media_player.lounge
    label: TV
    icon: mdi:television

presets.name: Energy
presets.yaml:
type: custom:area-glance-card
title: Energy
theme: dark
status:
  entity: sensor.net_energy_cost
  active_text: Net cost £2.53 today
  inactive_text: No cost data
metrics:
  - preset: power
    entity: sensor.home_power
    label: Home
    icon: mdi:home-lightning-bolt
  - preset: power
    entity: sensor.solar_power
    label: Solar
    icon: mdi:solar-power-variant
  - preset: battery
    entity: sensor.battery_soc
  - preset: power
    entity: sensor.grid_export
    label: Export
    icon: mdi:transmission-tower-export
